anomalies.description: A chaotic nighttime scene with dense smoke (likely tear gas or smoke grenades) engulfing a crowd behind metal barricades; individuals are seen moving erratically, some raising arms, others retreating or crouching amid the haze, consistent with a violent police crackdown on a protest.

A chaotic street scene with dense smoke (likely tear gas or smoke grenades), silhouetted individuals running and moving erratically, some appearing to throw objects or engage in confrontations near barricades; consistent visual indicators of violent unrest and group clashes.

A bright flash and rapidly expanding fireball visible in frame f8 (8.0s), followed by a large plume of smoke and debris in f9 (8.5s), consistent with a sudden detonation or incendiary device explosion on the street.

Sustained street-level unrest with multiple individuals moving through a smoke- and fire-filled urban environment; buildings and structures are visibly burning, and people are seen running or standing amid chaos, consistent with a riot.

Sustained fire inside a building with Greek signage ('ΕΘΝΙΚΗ ΤΡΑΠΕΖΑ ΤΗΣ ΕΛΛΑΔΟΣ'), consistent with arson during a violent protest or riot; the scene is presented as part of a news report alleging misattribution to Moscow protests.

Sustained violent unrest shown by a burning building (with Greek signage 'ΕΘΝΙΚΗ ΤΡΑΠΕΖΑ ΤΗΣ ΕΛΛΑΔΟΣ' — National Bank of Greece) and later split-screen footage showing riot police in formation on the left and chaotic fire-lit street activity on the right, consistent with a riot.

A dense crowd of people is engaged in chaotic, forceful movement around and against a metal barricade structure; individuals are pushing, climbing, and struggling with the barrier in a manner consistent with violent unrest or riotous behavior.
